valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 53.16, price over EPS 71.67); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2023, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
